formatter.invocation: rustfmt --edition 2024 --emit stdout, reading one generated .rs file on stdin
formatter.configuration: rustfmt defaults. Products contain no rustfmt.toml or .rustfmt.toml.
formatter.rule: Every generated .rs file is the formatter output for itself, so rustfmt --edition 2024 --check accepts it unchanged. The formatter hash is the Rust bundle formatter asset.

crates.sqlx_api: Runtime API only: sqlx::query, sqlx::query_as, sqlx::query_scalar with .bind, FromRow derive, Transaction, and sqlx::migrate! for the embedded migrator. The checked macros sqlx::query! and sqlx::query_as! are not used, so a build needs no database and no .sqlx offline data.
crates.no_other_crates: A product depends on exactly these crates. A change to a crate, version or feature is a contract amendment.

commands.environment: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true. A shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR is allowed. No network access.
commands.lock_unchanged: Cargo.lock bytes after the commands equal the generated Cargo.lock.

postgresql.cluster: A fresh initdb cluster per acceptance run, on a QA port other than 8765 and 18765, with UTF8 encoding and UTC time zone.

python.use: Python products, the parity harness and the contract scripts. The Python product dependency set is the one compiler-v1 already freezes.

reference_verification.crate: som_app with an axum router test and an sqlx runtime API probe
